additions.summary: [VS-E13-S05-ST01] Audit recipient resolution and invalid contacts
additions.actor: Authorized backoffice operator or trusted ViStay service
additions.outcome: Notification resolves event recipients through versioned authorization/contact snapshots, records explainable allow/deny decisions and routes invalid/missing contact to an operable exception without changing User data.
additions.context: Current welcome listener directly uses accountId and has no contact resolution/audit exception model. Planned V7 adds recipient policy/evidence after generalized intake.
inScope: Add V7 recipient rule/version, candidate/decision, contact snapshot reference, invalid-contact exception and resolution history with purpose/field-group evidence.

Resolve direct account, organization/branch role, booking party and explicit subscription recipients through User authorization/contact APIs; apply active account, partition, preference and mandatory policy.
Store only account/type, contact snapshot revision, masked destination plus encrypted delivery snapshot; never copy canonical profile or query another service database.
Classify no recipient, ambiguous/cross-partition recipient, missing/invalid/unverified contact, suppressed optional contact and dependency failure; allow audited re-resolve after User correction.
outOfScope: Frontend rendering outside the owning service contract.
Direct reads from another service database.
Production credentials, destructive history rewrites, or silent fallback authorization.
interfaces: Expose only the operations named in this issue through the owning GraphQL or gRPC boundary.
Return stable validation, forbidden, not-found, conflict, and dependency-unavailable codes.
Persist an outbox event in the same transaction for every externally observable state change.
dataOwnership: Notification owns durable inbox rows, template revisions, channel delivery snapshots, attempts, provider state, dead-letter/repair and notification audit; User owns canonical contact and identity; source services own domain facts; clients own only bounded display cursor state.
stateMachine: Resolution is PENDING -> RESOLVED/PARTIALLY_RESOLVED/NO_RECIPIENT/INVALID_CONTACT/FAILED_DEPENDENCY.
Exception is OPEN -> IN_REVIEW -> RE_RESOLVED/WAIVED/CANCELLED; mandatory notification cannot be waived without explicit policy.
Contact snapshot is immutable for a delivery; User correction creates a new resolution/delivery attempt revision.

dataPartitions: RECIPIENT_SELF for inbox/read/preference operations; ADMIN organization plus explicit notification-operations scope for templates, delivery repair and recipient exceptions; SYSTEM only for authenticated domain-event, contact-resolution and provider callbacks.
fieldGroups: NOTIFICATION_SUMMARY is baseline; DESTINATION, TEMPLATE_CONTENT, PROVIDER_DETAIL, PII, EXTERNAL_PAYLOAD and INTERNAL_AUDIT require explicit grants.

failureSemantics: Reject malformed/unversioned events, unresolved recipient, forbidden field/partition, invalid template variables, stale revision or unavailable required dependency before creating a delivery.
Use stable event, recipient, template, preference, provider, retry, cursor and authorization error codes without revealing destination, provider payload or another recipient notification.
Persist terminal failure/dead-letter and repair evidence; never silently drop a required notification or retry forever.
idempotencyConcurrency: Require an idempotency key for commands that can be retried externally and persist its request fingerprint and result.
Use aggregate version compare-and-swap so concurrent writers produce one winner and a stable conflict for losers.
Deduplicate consumed events by event ID and business key.

acceptanceCriteria.then: a classified visible exception results without canonical contact mutation or protected-data leakage

acceptanceCriteria.given: resolution/event/repair replays or contact revision changes
acceptanceCriteria.then: one decision per rule/recipient/revision remains and any re-resolution is linked rather than overwritten
